What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: the derivation must not let grep close the pipe early under pipefail (drop -q and redirect, or grep -c, or read the stripped text into a variable first - the coder's call), and the rege…
